title: Great!! But…
body: Everything is simple and great. Tracking, creating, focusing - but the complications on the AppleWatch are just really bad - would love to have the option to show progress of one particular habit (for example stepcount). body: Useful for keeping track of your habits, without it I would sometimes forget a few of all the things I had planned for the day.
